rationale: Despite the framing, this is exactly a top-two blend — the profitability leg is taken verbatim from IntangibleCapitalQualityHurdle and the hurdle leg verbatim from TotalAccrualHurdleQuality, both already measured against the same MIN baseline, so the outcome (~5% alpha, t≈5) is essentially predictable and adds no new economic content.

This is another mechanical cross of two already-tested variants (TotalAccrualHurdleQuality's dp-inclusive definition × WorstYearAccrualHurdle's TS_MAX statistic) on an unchanged profitability leg, and the "worst year" of a dp-inclusive accrual partly ranks firms on low depreciation rather than on aggressive recognition, muddying the stated tail-risk mechanism.

Changing the accrual deflator from assets to sales is a cosmetic normalization variant, and it is internally inconsistent with the hypothesis: the numerator retains −dp, so sales-scaling injects a depreciation-to-sales capital-intensity term that has nothing to do with the revenue-recognition decision the signal claims to screen.

The self-normalizing "accrual share of cumulative profit" idea is genuinely new to the archive, but the denominator TS_SUM(oibdp,5) can be near zero or negative, which inverts the ratio's sign for weak/loss firms and would reward exactly the accrual-inflated firms the hypothesis targets — a defect the MIN structure does not fix, contrary to the stated reasoning.

Trade-credit financing of the operating cycle measured as a stock is a legitimately untested dimension with a direction pre-committed by the archive's liability-side evidence, but the two legs are mechanically entangled (large lct−dlc shrinks the profitability leg's denominator), so the hurdle is only partly independent and the result will need that decomposition check.

A measurement-source robustness test of the accrual hurdle is a reasonable way to resolve the archive's conflicting gen-1/gen-2 evidence, and the sign convention is handled correctly (all three cash-flow items positive = cash released), though it remains a data-definition variant of an existing hurdle whose coverage loss may cap its informativeness.
